entities.name: Ike Omar Sanda Nwachukwu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ike Omar Sanda Nwachukwu mni ; born 1 September 1940) is a retired Nigerian Army major general and politician who served twice as Foreign Minister of Nigeria during the military regime of General Ibrahim Babangida, and as a Senator for Abia North from 1999 to 2003.
